body.says: The threads that wait on the author's word.

A matter raised in what was said and not yet owned by what is built: what it asks, where the author left it, the sentences it was raised in, and the briefs it bears on. The author's own words stay its ground, pointed at and never retold as settled; held as a holon because that is the respectful way to hold another's words.

asks.says: What it holds open, or what was said that steers, in the words of whoever raised it.

awaits.says: Whether it waits on the author's word: what he is to look at, the work going on meanwhile.

raised.says: The sentences it was raised in, as they were said: the author's, or a session's or an agent's, each voice its own.

stands.says: open, leaning, settled or let go: as the author left it, or, for a thread a session raised, as that session judged it until the author says. Each move is a commit, so since() finds what moved.

touches.says: The briefs it bears on, where one says more or less than the author did.

body.asks: Whether an act's gone takes a holon out of every store that holds it, each applying only what it holds, so that letting a holon go from one store alone is another act, not yet designed.

name: Gone means out of the field

body.asks: Whether a holon that already exists arrives in a store when a whole kept there comes to hold it, with what it holds in turn, and leaves a store when no whole there holds it any longer, so every store stays whole if taken away; or whether a whole may hold, across stores, what another store keeps.
